data.description:
## Incident Overview

### Scenario
User invokes `/dso:debug-everything`. Bug-Fix Mode gate detects N open + in_progress bug tickets (in this session, N=53). Per skill: "All bugs are in scope — including pre-existing ones. 'Pre-existing' means the bug existed before this session; it does not mean the bug should be skipped or deferred. Every open bug ticket must be investigated and resolved via `/dso:fix-bug`." Skill also specifies priority order: P0 → P1 → P2 → P3 → P4. There is no scope-confirmation gate in the skill.

### Expected Behavior
Orchestrator enters Bug-Fix Mode, lists all open + in_progress bug tickets ordered by priority, and proceeds to dispatch `/dso:fix-bug` at orchestrator level for each ticket without further user prompting. Graceful shutdown protocol handles context exhaustion.

### Actual Behavior
Orchestrator dispatched `AskUserQuestion` asking user to choose between scope variants (P1-only / P1+P2 / all 53 / triage Jira mirrors first). This contradicts the skill's explicit 'all bugs in scope' contract and inserts an unauthorized scope-narrowing gate. User reports this is recurring across sessions.

### Reproduction
1. Have ≥1 open or in_progress bug ticket.
2. Run `/dso:debug-everything`.
3. Observe orchestrator asks scope confirmation rather than proceeding.

### Suspected Root Cause
Orchestrator pattern-matches on 'large N' (e.g., 53) and improvises a scope-confirmation step not present in the skill. Skill text is unambiguous; the deviation is a model-level behavioral drift. Either:
- Skill needs an explicit anti-pattern guard ('NEVER ask user to narrow scope; all bugs in scope'), OR
- Bug-Fix Mode entry needs a hard-coded autonomy directive overriding model judgment.

### Files Likely Involved
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (Bug-Fix Mode section)

### Severity
P1: erodes skill autonomy contract; every recurring prompt costs user attention; shifts scope decisions from skill-defined defaults to ad-hoc model judgment.

### CLI_user
Reported by human user during interactive /dso:debug-everything session 2026-05-07.
data.title: [debug-everything orchestrator]: bug-fix mode entry with N open bugs -> AskUserQuestion for scope despite skill stating 'all bugs are in scope'
